subject: Extract list of elements and child elements from custom HTML drag-and-drop input widget

messages.author: a60d28d0ae3bdda8
messages.subject: Extract list of elements and child elements from custom HTML drag-and-drop input widget
parts:
Hi,

I want to add a custom input widget to a Shiny app that will take the form of an HTML drag-and-drop interface. The users will drag certain boxes into other boxes in the widget, and the input data that will get passed to Shiny is the locations of each of the dragged boxes.

But I do not know how to extract the necessary information from the HTML to pass it on to Shiny. All I really need is a list of ids of the layout elements, and the ids of their child elements.

Any tips or help would be greatly appreciated,

Thanks very much,

Louise
